text: The Building Resilience to Climate Change in Papua New Guinea initiative, administered by the Asian Development Bank, aims to enhance the country's resilience to climate-related hazards. The project focuses on deploying climate-resilience investments and embedding these within ADB’s environmental and social risk management system. It utilizes an Environmental Assessment and Review Framework (EARF) and Environmental and Social Monitoring Reports (ESMRs) to ensure compliance with environmental and social safeguards, transparency, and accountability.
